doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Conducting the cremation ceremony of the late Anunayake Thero of the Sri Lanka Ramagngna Maha Nikaya, Chief Incumbant of the Gatambe Rajopawanaramaya, Most Venerable Kappitiyagoda Siriwimalabhidhana Anunayaka Thero, with State Partonage
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - The cremation ceremony of the Anunayake Thero of the Sri Lanka Ramagngna Maha Nikaya, Chief Incumbant of the Peradeniya Gatambe Rajopawanaramaya, Sri Chandawimala Wansalankara, Chandakeerthi Sri Amarawansa Saddarma Vagheswara shasanahobhaana Most Venerable Kappitiyagoda Siriwimalabhidhana Anunayaka Thero who passed away on 2026-10-18 is scheduled to be held on 2026-10-21, at the Gatambe Municipal Council Grounds. The joint proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government; and the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to conduct the said cremation ceremony under state patronage, was approved by the Cabinet.
